text: BAM share rose 1.4 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.82 percentage points over 7 days to 37.8%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 22% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 68 top-node leadership changes in the window are best read as whale-driven routing rather than broad validator churn.
